youtube_description:
INTERPOL carries out a variety of training activities to equip investigators around the world with the knowledge and skills necessary to identify, target and dismantle transnational organized crime groups involved in the trafficking of counterfeit and illicit goods.

INTERPOL's international and regional training events are designed to enhance the ability of the law enforcement community to combat all types of counterfeiting and illicit trade.
Each event brings together a representative from every step of the investigative process, including police, customs, prosecution services, revenue authorities and brand holders to:
- Present their own case studies and experiences;
- Explain the nature and impact of illicit trade in their country;
- Train law enforcement officers on the latest techniques and procedures.

By sharing information, law enforcement agents are better equipped to support operational efforts in targeting transnational organized criminals involved in the manufacture and smuggling of counterfeited and pirated products.
